notes: C do_write parses with two_arguments; a one-argument write whose paper is missing prints "There is no %s in your inventory." (src/act.comm.c:1058-1062). The CLEAN live write-refusal-depth vehicle (in room 8162) prints it, and the unit test pins the message and that it is not the empty-argument line (R1/R2/R5e/R5h). Seed 1 retained; seeds 1,2,3,5,8 claimed.

C do_write's two_arguments makes the FIRST token the paper and the SECOND the pen (src/act.comm.c:1048-1056), so a two-argument write with a missing paper prints "You have no <paper>." naming the PAPER, not the pen. The CLEAN live write-refusal-depth vehicle (write nothing author -> "You have no nothing.") and the unit test pin it (R1/R2/R5e/R5h). Seed 1 retained; seeds 1,2,3,5,8 claimed.
A single carried object that is neither a pen nor a note yields "That thing has nothing to do with writing.".
Two arguments whose pen slot holds a non-pen yield "$p is no good for writing with.".
Two arguments whose note slot holds a non-note yield "You can't write on $p.".
A note plus a pen prints "Write your note.  End with '@' on a new line." to the actor and "$n begins to jot down a note." to the room, then opens the editor.
The 1000-byte note string_add path truncates the first overlong line or skips a later line, prints C's exact notice, and remains in writing mode.

PLR_NOSHOUT is checked before any argument handling: a muted writer answers C's exact "You cannot write anything!" for bare and full invocations (mute toggle from do_wizutil SCMD_SQUELCH, src/act.wizard.c:2131-2135) (R1/R2/R5e).

The one-argument path borrows the held object as the pen; a held quill made ITEM_INVISIBLE by cast 'invisibility' (src/magic.c:1918-1924) plus PRF_HOLYLIGHT toggled off fails CAN_SEE_OBJ (src/utils.h:540-542) and prints C's exact "The stuff in your hand is invisible!  Yeech!!" (R1/R2/R5e).

A NOTE whose action_description is set refuses a second write with C's exact "There's something written on it already." instead of opening the editor; the same gate is witnessed by look-note-text-depth (look.note-with-text) (R1/R2/R5e).
